4. After going through the record, it appears that the Habeas Corpus Writ Petition No. 19398 of 2021 was disposed of by this Court vide order dated 01.10.2021 which is quoted hereinabelow :-
" Heard Sri Akash Narayan, petitioner in person and learned AGA for the State.

entities.text: Habeas Corpus Writ Petition No. 19398 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Sri Akash Narayan states that in compliance of the order dated 23.9.2021, he could not bring a demand draft of Rs. 5,000/- drawn in the name of detenue due to financial crisis, therefore he may be granted 20 days time to pay the money.

In compliance of the Court's order dated 23.9.2021, the detenue, Pratima Seth @
Dolly is present in Court, who has been brought by S.I. Malti Prajapati and Head Constable Hansraj Yadav from Police Station, Mahila Thana, Varanasi.

Sri Akash Narayan, who has been mentioned in writ petition as husband of detenue,
has submitted that his wife Smt. Pratima Seth @ Dolly has been illegally detained by her mother in her maternal home.
On a query made by the Court, the detenue Pratima Seth @ Dolly states that she is major and has not been illegally detained by her mother.
At present she is residing with her mother in her maternal home by her own free will.
She does not want to go with her husband as the dispute and litigation is pending with her husband.
It has not been disputed that the detenue is major.
Since by the statement of the detenue in open Court, the fact reveals that she has not been illegally detained by her mother or anybody else.
The case of illegal detention of detenue is not made out by her statement in open court, hence the present Habeas Corpus petition has no force.
In view of the above, the detenue Pratima Seth @ Dolly is set at liberty.
She is free to go wherever she wants.

The Habeas Corpus petition is dismissed, accordingly. "
5.

It is to be noted that writ petition was finally disposed of on 01.10.2021 and thereafter this application has been moved by the applicant making certain allegations against the manner of investigation done by the police as well as the proceedings of the court in Domestic Violence Act and Section 125 Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: It appears that some cases are filed by the wife of the applicant which are pending.
The main grievance of the petitioner is that the police has not conducted fair investigation.
7. After looking to the record, I find that this is not a proper forum to raise his grievance.
All these issues raised in the application cannot be a subject matter in the present application.
If he has any grievance against the police regarding the investigation, this can be raised in the pending criminal case which has been lodged under sections 498A IPC against the applicant.
His grievances in the case under Section 125 Cr.P.C. and Domestic Violence Act cannot be looked into the present application.
8. The application is accordingly, dismissed.
9. However, it is open for the applicant to raise his grievance before the appropriate forum, if permissible in law.
